evidence.scope: Read-only source/archive review and pure memory-backed validation; retained suite logs inspected, not rerun. Filesystem read/absence adapters were replaced only for synthetic full-oracle replay.

finding.location: storage-fault-v1/oracle.py:690,717,728 validate_packet_order; storage-fault-v1/witness_owner.py:1008 validate_packet_schema and :1065 PacketState.validate
finding.defect: EOF.closed_fd is not checked against the persistent attempt-directory descriptor or live regular-file descriptors. Both validators accept closure of a capability that subsequent packets still use.
finding.mutation: From each valid fixture, set the first EOF.closed_fd to 5 (attempt dirfd), 10 (events fd), or 11 (request fd), one variant at a time. Refresh only supervisor-result.json witness_sha256.
finding.expected: Reject each alias at EOF. collector.patch:44 emits EOF immediately after closing a stream fd; collector.c:157,818,890 retains attempt_fd through report creation until close_resources. Events/request sinks also remain open until close_resources.
finding.observed: All 12 variants pass both packet validators and complete oracle.validate(root, selector, 0).
finding.correction: Reject EOF.closed_fd aliases of the persistent directory and currently live file capabilities in both pre-ACK and offline validation. Add negatives for every EOF stream on all four post-fork selectors. Preserve legitimate numeric descriptor reuse after actual retirement and directory-size changes.
finding.prior_fix: Persistent cross-site fd/dev/ino/mode identity and acquisition/request/BIND exclusions now reject the tested prior counterexamples.
